thread:
sam: Heads up—noticed ~200 token spike on /v1/stream for a single customer around 03:12 UTC.
sam: Looks correlated with route fallback from eu-west -> us-central after a short hw flake. :thinking_face:
billing-bot: alert: provisional_charge created for customer acct_9X at 2026-03-19T03:12:09Z amount=0.0023 tokens=198 session=ss-4z9
mae: I pulled the request trace. client disconnected, runtime retried on fallback node, the fallback resumed stream but with no shared resume-id so both segments were recorded as separate sessions.
mae: snippet from runtime logs:
```
INFO resume_attempt request_id=rid-33a X-Route-Fallback=true resume_id=null prefetched_tokens=40 sent_tokens=158
WARN no_resume_id -> emitting provisional ledger entry
```
vivek: oof; so the ledger sees two non-overlapping streams and bills both partly. Are we double-counting overlapping tokens or is one marked provisional?
sam: Both were provisional at first, then a finalize event for the second arrived and we didn't reconcile the provisional from the first (it was never cleared).
mae: The root cause is missing stream-session id and the tool_call TTL flow. When a tool_call is in-flight and we fallback, the fallback runtime treats it as a fresh toolcall and duplicates token ledger lines.
vivek: Proposal: attach a strong idempotency header to every streaming session (X-Stream-Session, UUIDv4) and carry it across route handoffs. Fallback should check for existing resume_id in the global session store before creating a new provisional ledger entry.
sam: Agreed. Also we should change the console to surface provisional vs finalized token columns for affected sessions so SREs can easily spot ghost charges.
mae: Quick heuristic: on finalize event, if there's an earlier provisional with overlapping token ranges for same customer+stream_id, mark earlier provisional as reconciled and emit negative adjustment.
vivek: Implementation notes:
- runtime: propagate X-Stream-Session and include last_seq/token-offset in heartbeat
- router: forward resume data in fallback header
- billing: store provisional entries keyed by (customer, stream_session)
- console: add toggle "show provisional" and expose adjustments in timeline
sam: Can someone own a small spike mitigation? We should rollback provisional entries for that customer and issue a refund if needed.
mae: I can run a one-off script to reconcile by matching request_ids and timestamps. Will need a listing of provisional entries from billing table.
sam: @vivek can you add the header plumbing and a simple reconcile hook in billing? If not, assign and we can pair.
vivek: I'll pick it up. Will push a small runtime change (non-breaking) to add X-Stream-Session and a reconciliation endpoint. Target: patch release by EOD tomorrow.
deploy-bot: deploy trigger: staging runtime patch 2026-03-19T10:05Z -> queued
billing-bot: note: created ticket BILL-4312 provisional-adjustments for acct_9X
sam: Thanks. Also follow-up item: UX for "provisional tokens" in the billing view; let's loop in product/devex. :eyes:
